description: This file defines a HomeController class for managing the state and logic related to the home feed in a Flutter application. It handles data fetching, caching, error states, and notifies listeners of state changes.

classes.name: HomeController
classes.description: A controller class that manages the state and data fetching logic for the home feed in the app, including caching and error handling.
